classes: The list of figures: a <ul>. As many columns as fit; one on phones.
For a dark background, such as a page heading: white text and outlines.
One figure: an <li>, with an edge in the institution’s colour.
A figure that needs action, such as “5 overdue”: a red edge. Say why in the label.
The number, with its unit: large and bold.
Optional: how it has changed, and compared with what, in words.
django:
{# figures: dicts with value, label, and optionally change and danger #}
{% ggds_key_figures figures %}
